base_member_text: the time label multiplier 20 s (L47) is the assumed output interval; not verifiable from this file
audit_member_text: Displayed time is hard-coded as `files(num)*20` at L47 rather than read from output metadata or tied to FrameRate/output cadence; changing the file-index stride does not validate the assumed 20 s model-output interval.

base_member_text: files=[10:10] (L27) renders a single frame, so the resulting 'movie' has one frame; presumably a leftover from debugging a longer range
audit_member_text: `vort1` from L45 is never used, and the current `files=[10:10]` at L27 produces a one-frame movie despite the general loop/movie structure.

base_member_text: vorticity colorbar is labeled '(1/s^2)' (L98) though vorticity has units 1/s
audit_member_text: The curl at L45 is a spatial derivative of velocity and therefore has inverse-time units, but the third-panel colorbar labels vorticity as `1/s^2` at L98; this is a dimensional-label defect (it should be inverse seconds for u,v in m/s and x,y in m).

base_member_text: subplot comments at L54, L71, L88 all say 'plot total depth' though panels 2 and 3 show speed and vorticity
frame capture at -r300 on an 8x12 inch figure yields very large frames; commented imresize to 1024x576 (L15-L16, L110) was abandoned

audit_member_text: No dimension consistency check relates dep, mask, u, v, and eta before common logical indexing and mesh operations (L33-L45); any differently shaped field fails or silently misrepresents coordinates.
Dry cells are set to NaN before `curl` (L38-L45), so MATLAB's finite differences can propagate NaNs into wet cells adjacent to the mask boundary; the source applies no one-sided boundary treatment.
